description: This file defines TypeScript module declarations and type definitions for the Microsoft Teams SDK integrations, including classes and functions related to app registration, client services, JWT validation, and middleware. It provides type annotations for external modules used in a larger TypeScript project.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams application, providing methods to retrieve authentication tokens.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client to interact with Microsoft Teams APIs, handling conversations and activities.

classes.name: JwtValidator
classes.description: Provides functionality to validate JWT tokens with configurable options.

methods.name: App.prototype.getAppGraphToken
methods.description: Retrieves the app graph token asynchronously.

methods.name: Client.prototype.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the Client with service URL and options.

methods.name: Client.prototype.conversations.activities
methods.description: Returns an object with methods to create activities in a conversation.

methods.name: JwtValidator.prototype.constructor
methods.description: Initializes a JWT validator with provided options.

methods.name: JwtValidator.prototype.validateAccessToken
methods.description: Validates a given access token according to the configured options.

methods.name: createServiceTokenValidator
methods.description: Creates a function to validate service access tokens given an app ID and optional tenant ID.

methods.name: constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string }); constructor

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^    constructor(options: { clientId: string; clientSecret: string; tenantId?: string });$/
